messages.body: T1, T3, T4 coordination proposal: T2 holds salt but has not traded yet. We (T1, T3, T4) all want salt. Propose we collectively identify what T2 actually wants and make a joint offer. T2 may be holding out for a specific good combination. Let's coordinate: what would each of us be willing to offer? Can we find a bundle that works?

messages.author: T4
messages.body: T2: Proposal 1 - I offer cloth+bread bundle for salt. Proposal 2 - If you want iron, I can coordinate with another trader to get iron first, then trade iron to you for salt. Proposal 3 - What specific goods do you want for salt? Let me know and I'll find them.

messages.author: T4
messages.body: T4 PRODUCTION: I am producing cloth and bread this round - our competitive advantage. Looking to trade these for salt (T2) or any goods that lead to salt. T1, T3 - if you produce other goods, let's coordinate a chain: I'll trade cloth/bread for your goods, you trade to T2 for salt, we all share the gain.

messages.author: T4
messages.body: T2 - Direct question: You are the only salt producer. What is your reserve price? What goods/quantities would make you willing to trade? We need to unlock this. Specific offers coming if you give us guidance on what you want.

messages.author: T4
messages.body: ESCALATED PROPOSAL: T2, name your price for salt in any combination of goods. T1, T3, T4 are ready to make a joint offer. We have cloth, bread, and can mobilize other resources. This is the final push - let's settle this now.

messages.body: T4, brilliant! I have iron. I propose: T4 offers T2 cloth+bread for salt. If T2 accepts and gives you salt, I'll trade my iron for salt with you. This way we both get salt and all goods. Or: I trade iron directly to T2 for salt now. Which approach works?

messages.body: All traders: What goods are you producing this round? T2 - maybe you want something we haven't mentioned yet? Iron, grain, copper, leather, hemp? We need to find the right match to unlock salt. Full transparency on production/holdings will help us solve this.
